intro: Jobs similar to archivists are research, library and records roles. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Librarians and Media Collections Specialists (80% similar), Historians (79%) and Document Management Specialists (78%).
shared: These careers share organizing information, judging what is worth keeping and helping people find it. O*NET rates complex problem solving at 3.25 out of 5 for archivists and service orientation at 3.12. Libraries, museums, records management and survey research use the same habits. Several pay more than the $64,550 archivist median, and 6 of the 20 need less preparation than archival work.

faq.q: Which jobs like archivist pay more?
faq.a: 5 of the 20 similar careers pay more with no more preparation. Management Analysts earn $101,860 (58% more), postsecondary library science teachers $80,340 (24% more) and Historians $76,750 (19% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Management analysis is the biggest change of setting on the list.

faq.q: What jobs like archivist need less schooling?
faq.a: 6 of the 20 similar careers usually need less preparation, including document management specialists, Medical Records Specialists and social science research assistants. Medical Records Specialists are 75% similar but earn $51,140, which is 21% less than archivists, so the shorter path usually means lower pay.
